market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure over 1–3 months as RBA rate uncertainty, housing correction fears, and construction contagion dominate. Iron ore volatility and Victoria debt warnings add headwinds. Small-cap metals and gas names may outperform. Expect elevated volatility around RBA communications.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook is cautiously constructive if RBA pauses and housing stabilises. AI capex cycle, EV transition, and critical minerals demand provide structural tailwinds. However, construction sector fragility and potential credit losses could delay a sustained recovery. 'Bull case returns' narrative needs confirmation through earnings.
